images.caption: Figure 1:Overview ofWorldFoundry.Open-source infrastructure for generative world models. (1) one run is reachable from every interactive and programmatic surface; (2) preflight requests execute through a unified runner, one-shot or session-resident; (3) outputs are persisted behind durable artifact contracts with typed references; (4) benchmarks score persist in artifacts reported in an evidence scorecard; and (5) declarative manifests bind discovery, runtime and evaluation, keeping claims traceable to evidence.
